bookmarks.title: Implanted heart device explodes, causing fire that killed father, 3-year-old son: Lawsuit
bookmarks.description: The widow of a man has filed a lawsuit alleging a series of failures led to the deaths of her husband and 3-year-old son after a medical heart pump device implanted in her husband exploded.
